mechanism: Training environment, plan-boosted trajectory harvesting and fine-tuning of an open model for SQL issue debugging
evidence_scope: We further propose f-Plan Boosting, which extracts high-level debugging plans automatically from SQL solutions, enabling the teacher LLMs to harvest and produce 73.7% more successful trajectories for training.
evidence_role: we present SIX-GYM (Sql-fIX-Gym), a training environment for elevating the capabilities of open-source models specifically for SQL issue debugging.
